decision: supported for public release as a scoped independent core-mechanism replication and local paired-generation study
review_method: Read-only review of paper-to-experiment correspondence, pinned source boundaries, runner and validator code, saved raw results, completed notebook and figures; a separate manual standard-library pass recomputed acceptable-argument counts directly from the raw 64 model outputs. No model inference, benchmark rerun, runner helper import or generated-function execution was performed by this reviewer.

paper.correspondence: Section 4.1 motivates the static/dynamic compilation workload; section 3.2 motivates TagDispatch fixtures; section 4.3 supplies the Qwen3-0.6B/BFCL setting and Appendix I supplies correctness context. The harness and strict scoring protocol are independently authored adaptations.

resolved.issue: Potential conflation of total cache benefit with cross-request benefit
resolved.resolution: The final README and summary distinguish disabled/persistent from reset_each_request/persistent and report the dynamic negative result.

resolved.issue: Potential conflation of formatting improvement with semantic improvement
resolved.resolution: The final README and figure show strict-tool success separately from the whole-Markdown-fence-relaxed content diagnostic, which remains 27/32 in both modes.

resolved.issue: Version mismatch between initial release and final paper revision
resolved.resolution: The README pins v0.2.0 and explicitly excludes an inference that all August v4 optimizations or configurable JIT are verified.

resolved.issue: Incomplete notebook/document release state during the intermediate review
resolved.resolution: The results placeholder has been replaced, six code cells are saved with ordered execution counts, and the final independent validation includes the notebook.

included: Official v0.2.0 library with independent one-thread CPU static/dynamic workload harness
Same-version cache-lifecycle ablation over fixed public BFCL tool schemas
TagDispatch positive/negative fixture checks and CPU mask-kernel checks
Greedy Qwen3-0.6B CPU-mask/Metal paired generation on the first 32 fixed BFCL v3 simple tasks
Independent provenance, input, token-mask, scoring, summary and notebook checks
excluded: Full paper reproduction or recreation of all original figures and tables
Old XGrammar v0.1.19 versus XGrammar-2 engine comparison
Configurable JIT, repetition-compression or parser ablation claims
SGLang server, CUDA/B200/5090 throughput, batch-size scaling or zero-overhead inference claims
All CONFETTI tasks, all BFCL categories or official leaderboard score
Guaranteed semantic correctness or general Agent improvement

version_limits.paper_version: arXiv v4, 2026-08-05; the fixed released implementation predates this revision
version_limits.hf_adapter_adjustment: Batch-size-one subsequent state transitions pass Python integer token IDs, while retaining the author matcher and CPU mask kernel; this compatibility adjustment is disclosed.
version_limits.comparison_limits: Three seeded workload repeats and one Mac are not broad hardware evidence. Thirty-two source-order simple tasks are not representative full-BFCL sampling. New-process output equality does not guarantee cross-machine or cross-dtype equality.

claims_not_supported_by_this_artifact: Dynamic cross-request cache acceleration observed on this machine
Official BFCL score or official submission
New peer-reviewed research publication or original-author endorsement

publication_integrity: Public release should retain the documented negative findings and scope. Model weights, original BFCL inputs, author source archives and environment are excluded from the public snapshot; pinned downloaders and provenance hashes are supplied. Model answer errors are part of the empirical report, while validation checks confirm truthful bookkeeping.
